biggest_catch: The headline bonuses only pay if your referral clears real hurdles — 300 eligible points in 30 days for the 480-point bonus, and a $20+ single purchase for the 750-point bonus — and the 10% is variable, not guaranteed.
catches: 480-point bonus credits the day after the referral earns 300 eligible points within 30 days.
750-point bonus requires the referral to spend at least $20 in a single transaction.

Referral-earning exclusions: signup bonuses, courtesy credits, Point Perks, Buying Points, Gambit, Daily Goal bonuses, MyGiftCardsPlus bonuses, and referral bonuses do not count toward the 300-point threshold or the 10%.
Purchase exclusions apply, including Amazon.com and MyPoints Games plus store-specific exclusions.
10% of eligible referral earnings pays for the account's lifetime while both accounts stay open and compliant — but it is variable, never a guaranteed amount.
Paid search and manipulated direct traffic to generate referrals are prohibited.
